reading.body:
This entry does not represent a data center facility. Emailage was a fraud-prevention software company acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions, a consumer of cloud infrastructure rather than an operator of one. The address on file now hosts a different tenant, Safe T Professionals LLC.

The location was likely tagged in OpenStreetMap as telecom infrastructure but does not correspond to any published server or hosting operation. Reverse geocoding of the stored coordinates in Maricopa County, Arizona returns a current occupant unrelated to Emailage or data center operations. No sources connect this Chandler address to compute capacity, power infrastructure, or colocation services.

This facility should not be counted in Arizona's AI infrastructure. It contributes no measurable power draw or computational capacity to the state's ability to support AI scaling. Arizona has 56 mapped facilities in this dataset, only 4 with published capacity figures totaling 512 MW. Misidentified office addresses dilute the visibility of actual buildings and power that constrain AI deployment.
